crossRefs.note: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.
We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t…

translations.web: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.
translations.bsb: They do no iniquity; they walk in His ways.
translations.kjv: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.
translations.asv: Yea, they do no unrighteousness; They walk in his ways.
